name: com.drivemode.timberlorry.internal.authenticator.StubAuthenticatorService
description: Android connects to this Drivemode TimberLorry service while setting up scheduled log syncing, making the SDK's log-collection job available to the system.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents TimberLorry's sync account from being set up for log collection, but does not affect the host app's own features.
